selection_rule.eligibility: ensemble MAE and RMSE must both be less than or equal to Random Walk
selection_rule.fallback: alpha=0.0 when no candidate is eligible

success_criteria.overall: ensemble MAE and RMSE must both be lower than Random Walk
success_criteria.origin_consistency: ensemble must beat Random Walk on both MAE and RMSE in at least 4 of 7 origins

locked_2026_evaluation.small_sample_warning: Seven monthly origins are insufficient for a strong generalization claim.

test_data_policy: do not use 2022-2025 final test or 2026 observations to select or revise alpha
